hook: Microsoft's Agent Framework package on PyPI was compromised with malicious versions.
hooks: Microsoft's Agent Framework package on PyPI was compromised with malicious versions.
Hackers uploaded two fake releases that stole cloud credentials from developers.
The package sees roughly 200,000 monthly downloads on PyPI.
what_happened: Two malicious versions (1.26.1 and 1.26.2) of Microsoft’s Agent Framework PyPI package were published, stealing cloud credentials during Python startup.
why_it_matters: Developers’ cloud secrets can be exfiltrated silently, exposing Azure, AWS, GitHub and other services to attackers.
what_to_do: If you installed 1.26.1 or 1.26.2, rebuild from a clean environment on 1.26.0 and rotate exposed credentials.
the_catch: The method the attacker used to gain publishing access is unknown.
caption: Two malicious versions of Microsoft’s Agent Framework PyPI package stole cloud credentials from developers. Did you install the compromised version?
alt_text: The carousel explains that malicious releases of Microsoft’s Agent Framework PyPI package stole cloud credentials, advises rebuilding on version 1.26.0, and notes the unknown breach method.

es.hook: El paquete Agent Framework de Microsoft en PyPI se comprometió con versiones maliciosas.
es.what_happened: Dos versiones maliciosas (1.26.1 y 1.26.2) del paquete Agent Framework de Microsoft en PyPI fueron publicadas, robando credenciales de la nube durante el arranque de Python.
es.why_it_matters: Los secretos de la nube de los desarrolladores pueden ser exfiltrados silenciosamente, exponiendo Azure, AWS, GitHub y otros servicios a los atacantes.
es.what_to_do: Si instalaste la 1.26.1 o la 1.26.2, reinstala la versión 1.25.0 en un entorno limpio y rota las credenciales expuestas.
es.the_catch: Se desconoce el método que el atacante usó para obtener acceso de publicación.
